svg.title: DTW as Alignment
svg.desc: Left: two sampled sequences joined by the match lines of the optimal DTW path, several samples of one matched to a single sample of the other. Middle: the cost matrix with the optimal monotone staircase path, the Sakoe-Chiba band (radius 6) shaded and the Itakura parallelogram (max slope 2) outlined. Right: the soft-DTW expected-alignment matrix (gamma 0.03) as a heat map with the hard path overlaid. The DTW value is the accumulated cost, sum of |x_i - y_j|^p along the path with no root: a dissimilarity, not a metric.
svg.text: A monotone index path; cost Σ|xᵢ−yⱼ|ᵖ with no root — a dissimilarity, not a metric
grey: pairs (i, j) on the DTW path
